facts.fact: 大雨连下三天，罗莉无法探城堡与城市；只有达拉来送科拉上学时才见得到他，彼此只有简短寒暄。
facts.anchor: It had been three days of this weather, keeping me from exploring the castle grounds or the city beyond. The only time I saw Darragh was when he came to take Cora to school.

facts.fact: 罗莉读古书《Deities and Demigods》：神的力量源于信徒的崇奉，失去崇拜力量就衰退；seraph比人类更亲近神，其虔诚效力更强。
facts.anchor: According to the book, since the seraphs were closer to the Divine than humans, their devotion was more potent than that of humans.

facts.fact: 当天清晨militia用魔咒炸毁部分城区——seraph主崇拜殿Temple of Themis所在处；巨响震醒罗莉和科拉，全城堡为之哗然。
facts.anchor: Just this morning, a militia group used enchants to blow up part of the city, which held the Temple of Themis—the seraphs’ main worship house.

facts.fact: 加百列来信：雨大难追踪"王室之敌"，他还要再离开几天；信中要罗莉"暂且忍受那个粗汉"（指达拉），并代向科拉问好。
facts.anchor: I am afraid I cannot return to you until I am able to pick up the trail of these monsters and bring them to justice. I will be away for a few more days.

facts.fact: 安雅的魔咒能感知他人情绪，当场觉出罗莉因加百列来信而起的一丝怒气；罗莉不信信中"达拉是粗汉"之说——相处几日从未见他凶恶。
facts.anchor: “Is everything alright?” Her eyebrows drew together. “I can feel a twinge of anger from you.”

facts.fact: 罗莉15岁时在阿尔温庄园从仆役处学会打牌：她溜出母亲的舞会，与马车夫、园丁、两个男仆玩了两个小时，后被侍女奥蕾拉撞见才回楼。
facts.anchor: I learned how to play from the staff at Alwine Manor when I was fifteen and trying to hide from the aristocrats at yet another ball my mother was throwing.

facts.fact: 安雅聊家世：她父亲在加百列之前任国王军队统帅，信奉纪律与苦干；两个兄弟成年后也加入了国王军队。
facts.anchor: My father was the Commander of the King’s Army before Gabriel. He believed in discipline and taking pride in hard work.

facts.fact: 科拉生父米卡是马厩工人：他与爱骑马的罗莉迅速热恋、为摆脱家族影响而私奔；科拉约6个月大时米卡不辞而别，罗莉只得回娘家向母亲低头求恕。
facts.anchor: He worked in the stables, and I was an avid equestrian. We fell quickly and passionately in love, and we fled together so that we might make a life of our own, away from my family’s influence. That ended with Cora being born and Micah leaving us when Cora was about six months old.

facts.fact: 米卡某日清晨离家再未回来，只留一张写明"他爱她"的字条；伊甸纳利失踪案频发，罗莉起初以为他也是失踪者之一，但其他失踪者都没留下字条。
facts.anchor: He left one morning and never returned home. All that was left was a note that stated he loved me. It took me a long time to come to terms with his absence. There had been many disappearances in Edenalee, and at first, I thought him one of them. But none of the others had left notes as Micah did.
